_id: prod005_productInterval5s -- tower clock product rebroadcast interval = 5 s. Does the tower-clock broadcast product cause the two-way channel's innovation autocorrelation? The reference run reports rho(1) = 0.725 on the two-way rows, the highest of any channel, against 0.31 on code and 0.09 on Doppler. Removing multipath leaves it bit-identical, so it is not the code-channel mechanism. The product is held for updateInterval_s and extrapolated linearly, which makes its residual smooth within each window, so if the product is the cause then rho(1) must rise with the interval. PREDICTION: rho(1) increases monotonically from the 5 s rung to the 90 s rung. A flat result across an 18x span refutes the hypothesis and the cause lies elsewhere.
_delta: PRODUCT-INTERVAL PROBE 1/3. Shortest rebroadcast. The tower clock product re-anchors every 5 s, so the residual the linear extrapolation cannot follow is reset six times more often than the reference.
